_purpose: The single record of the measured facts about the committed art. docs/bootstrap.md -> 'Key contracts to establish first' #1 requires that grid math be MEASURED from the bytes, never inferred from a filename or re-derived from ticket prose. _verification.what_pending_means: Entries whose provenance is 'declared' carry the numbers written in docs/bootstrap.md; entries whose provenance is 'unmeasured' have no recorded dimensions at all because the prose never stated any. NOTHING in this file has been measured against the committed bytes yet -- this workspace has no macOS/sips/Xcode. `bash ./verify_assets.sh` performs the sips sweep, FAILS on any 'declared' value that disagrees with the real PNG, FAILS on any grid that does not divide evenly into the measured sheet, and prints the measured width/height for every 'unmeasured' entry so it can be recorded here. Run it on a macOS checkout and replace provenance with 'measured' + set measured_on before any consumer trusts a number below.
_verification.hard_rule: A consumer may only use a value whose provenance is 'measured'. Do not copy numbers out of the ticket table or bootstrap prose into slicing code.

cell_grid_convention: columns = pixel_width / cell_width (animation frames), rows = pixel_height / cell_height (facing directions). Art is authored once at 1x (no @2x/@3x renditions, ever) and compressed losslessly (compression-type: none).
